name: brown_snake_eagle_carrying_mamba
description: Brown snake eagle flying up and to the right with both wings raised, gripping an olive-grey black mamba (library palette) in its grey talons near the snake's front third. The snake dangles below in a long S-curve to about y +540, still twisting: tail curled at the bottom, head turned up beside the eagle's feet, mouth closed. No blood, no wounds. Anchor at the eagle's body centre; bbox about x -335..+260, y -260..+545.
